defect.reproducer: ros2 launch course_bringup patrol.launch.py namespace:=robot_a subscriber_reliability:=reliable record:=false, then `timeout 30s ros2 topic echo /robot_a/sensor_pose --qos-reliability reliable --once`. The topic is in `ros2 topic list`, `ros2 topic info --verbose` shows 1 publisher (pose_relay, BEST_EFFORT) and 1 subscription (sensor_listener, RELIABLE), but no message ever arrives: echo exits 124, the listener received 0 messages (evidence/pr05/qos-before.txt).
defect.root_cause: A RELIABLE subscription requests more than a BEST_EFFORT publisher offers. QoS compatibility is checked per endpoint pair: when the requested reliability is stronger than the offered one the pair is incompatible and DDS delivers nothing, although the topic name and type match and both endpoints are discovered. The only symptom is a warning about incompatible QoS (RELIABILITY) from rclpy/ros2cli and the incompatible-QoS event of the subscription.
defect.proof_after: With subscriber_reliability:=best_effort (and --qos-reliability best_effort for echo) the same topic delivers: echo exits 0 with a Pose, the listener logs received messages and no incompatible-QoS event, and ros2 bag record -s mcap stores 2447 messages of one stream. Playing that same bag with config/qos-overrides.yaml reproduces both outcomes: reliable echo times out, best_effort echo receives a pose (evidence/pr05/qos-after.txt, bag-metadata.yaml).
